noun_definition: Taxes settings refers to the configuration options within the workspace editor that allow users to manage default tax rates, specifically enabling or disabling them in the context of online and offline access.
Default tax rate refers to the predefined tax categories, specifically "Tax exempt" and "Tax Rate 1," that are available in the workspace editor when the tax toggle is enabled.
offline refers to the state of the device being disconnected from the internet, which affects the accessibility of certain features in the application.
